requirements.quote:
The selector must be an enumerated
   type that defines the possible variants the structure defines.
requirements.condition: when a structure uses a variant selector
requirements.required_behavior: define the selector as an enumerated type whose values define the structure's possible variants
requirements.why_checkable: The variant declaration can be inspected to verify the selector type and its enumerated alternatives.

requirements.quote:
Each
   arm of the select (below) specifies the type of that variant's field
   and an optional field label.
requirements.condition: for each arm of a select declaration
requirements.required_behavior: specify the type of the field represented by that variant
requirements.forbidden_behavior: define a select arm without a variant field type
requirements.why_checkable: Each select arm has concrete syntax that can be parsed and checked for a field type.

requirements.quote:
Each
   arm of the select (below) specifies the type of that variant's field
   and an optional field label.
requirements.condition: for a field label in a select arm
requirements.required_behavior: permit the field label to be present or omitted
requirements.forbidden_behavior: require every select arm to have a field label
requirements.why_checkable: A presentation-language parser can be tested with labeled and unlabeled select arms.
